text: Oh, damn it.

text: Can

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I have a napkin?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'm sorry, no.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: But you have a whole bunch of'em.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Yes, I've moved to a four-napkin system. Lap, hands, face and personal emergencies. If you like, starting tomorrow, I'll add a guest napkin, but I'm afraid there's nothing I can do for you today. Good luck. That's the face napkin.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: So, have you talked to Penny yet?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: No, I haven't. Because I've been busy, because I haven't figured out a way to bring it up, and mostly, and I can't stress how key this is, because I don't want to.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Why not?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Leonard, a pact is a pact. You have to get Penny to fix me up.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: It's not that simple. What am I supposed to say? Penny, do you have any friends you'd like to never hear from again?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Come on, I'm smart, I have good job and I have only three percent body fat.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: It's true. I've seen him at the beach, he's like a human chicken wing.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Leonard, come on.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Fine. I'll ask if she has a friend for you.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: A hot friend. And tall. I want our kids to be able to ride space mountain before they're 20.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Right.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I'll see what I can do.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Hey, Sheldon, guess what I heard today?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'd imagine you heard any number of things today. When you arrived at work you undoubtedly heard, hello, Raj, how are you, Raj? Given that you're wearing a new sweater-vest, you may have heard new sweater-vest? And possibly, though far less likely, nice sweater-vest.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Why don't I just tell you what I heard today.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: That would probably save us some time.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Saturday night at the comic book store, they're having a Mystic Warlords of Ka-ah tournament. First prize is five hundred dollars. If we team up, we'd be unstoppable.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'm sorry, Raj, but I have no interest in playing a game in which I find no challenge.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: What about the money? But this is other money.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I have money.

text: How does it different from the money I have?

text: Half of it will be mine.
